objects.description: Open-source threat actor intelligence exported by proshiba/threatactor-intel-analysis.

objects.name: System Network Connections Discovery
objects.description: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) has enumerated existing network connections on victim devices.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)
objects.x_analyst_notes: MITRE ATT&CK actor-level procedure example. No activity period is inferred from source publication or relationship modification dates.

objects.name: Unix Shell
objects.description: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) used a custom tool, VELVETSTING, to parse encoded inbound commands to compromised F5 BIG-IP devices and then execute them via the Unix shell.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)
objects.x_analyst_notes: MITRE ATT&CK actor-level procedure example. No activity period is inferred from source publication or relationship modification dates.

objects.name: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
objects.description: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) has transferred tools within victim environments using SMB.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)
objects.x_analyst_notes: MITRE ATT&CK actor-level procedure example. No activity period is inferred from source publication or relationship modification dates.

objects.name: Disable or Modify System Firewall
objects.description: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) modified system firewall settings during [PlugX](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0013) installation using `netsh.exe` to open a listening, random high number port on victim devices.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)
objects.x_analyst_notes: MITRE ATT&CK actor-level procedure example. No activity period is inferred from source publication or relationship modification dates.

objects.name: Non-Standard Port
objects.description: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) has used random high number ports for [PlugX](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0013) listeners on victim devices.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)
objects.x_analyst_notes: MITRE ATT&CK actor-level procedure example. No activity period is inferred from source publication or relationship modification dates.

objects.name: Network Sniffing
objects.description: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) has used a custom tool, "VELVETTAP", to perform packet capture from compromised F5 BIG-IP devices.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)
objects.x_analyst_notes: MITRE ATT&CK actor-level procedure example. No activity period is inferred from source publication or relationship modification dates.

objects.name: Lateral Tool Transfer
objects.description: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) transferred files laterally within victim networks through the [Impacket](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0357) toolkit.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)
objects.x_analyst_notes: MITRE ATT&CK actor-level procedure example. No activity period is inferred from source publication or relationship modification dates.

objects.name: Disable or Modify Tools
objects.description: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) attempted to disable local security tools and endpoint detection and response (EDR) software during operations.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)
objects.x_analyst_notes: MITRE ATT&CK actor-level procedure example. No activity period is inferred from source publication or relationship modification dates.

objects.name: File and Directory Discovery
objects.description: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) has enumerated local files and folders on victim devices.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)
objects.x_analyst_notes: MITRE ATT&CK actor-level procedure example. No activity period is inferred from source publication or relationship modification dates.

objects.name: Local Accounts

objects.name: RC Scripts

objects.name: Match Legitimate Resource Name or Location

objects.name: Internal Proxy

objects.name: Process Injection

objects.name: Service Execution

objects.name: Data Encoding

objects.name: Exploitation for Stealth

objects.name: External Remote Services

objects.x_analyst_notes: MITRE ATT&CK actor-level procedure example. No activity period is inferred from source publication or relationship modification dates.

objects.name: Velvet Ant
objects.description: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) is a threat actor operating since at least 2021. [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) is associated with complex persistence mechanisms, the targeting of network devices and appliances during operations, and the use of zero day exploits.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024B)

objects.name: Impacket
objects.description: [Impacket](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0357) is an open source collection of modules written in Python for programmatically constructing and manipulating network protocols. [Impacket](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0357) contains several tools for remote service execution, Kerberos manipulation, Windows credential dumping, packet sniffing, and relay attacks.(Citation: Impacket Tools)
